study_area: Bangladesh Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT), district polygons

region_filter.name: CHT districts (Bandarban, Khagrachhari, Rangamati)
region_filter.source: geoBoundaries BGD-ADM2 (BBS / OCHA ROAP), CC BY 3.0, data/reference/geoBoundaries-BGD-ADM2_simplified.geojson

coverage_gaps_note: Contiguous months with no downloaded chunk inside the grid. They are delivery gaps, not fire-free months, and stay blank rather than becoming zeros.

per_district.note: Independent district fits on the identical split; each carries its own bootstrap interval and scalar baseline.

noaa20_model.direction: NOAA-20 VIIRS -> S-NPP-equivalent counts (then the published S-NPP -> MODIS line)
noaa20_model.reason: only 0 overlapping months; at least 24 are required
noaa20_model.caveat: Until this leg is fitted on at least 24 S-NPP / NOAA-20 overlap months, the forward VIIRS-equivalent mapping remains an algebraic inversion and must not be used operationally.

sensor_custody.note: Each record month belongs to exactly one leg. Months after the last downloaded archive (2021-12) are shown as a delivery gap, not as NOAA-20 observations. The NOAA-20/21 leg starts on 2026-11.

observed_sensor_shift_ratio_definition: mean raw VIIRS (2012+) / mean MODIS (2002-2011), zero months counted on both sides — the discontinuity drawn in Chart A
overlap_viirs_to_modis_ratio_definition: mean raw VIIRS / mean MODIS over the same overlap months (the sensor sensitivity difference)

modis_only_continuity.interpretation: Same instrument, same region, no instrument change: the MODIS record does not rise across the 2012 boundary, so the step seen in the spliced series is a sensor artefact, not a fire trend.

zero_month_handling.handling: zero months retained; log1p variant used as the zero-robust check

fitted_linear_model.bootstrap_method: 500 resamples of contiguous 12-month blocks (moving-block bootstrap, seed 42); coefficient interval, not a prediction interval
fitted_linear_model.interpretation: fitted regional empirical relationship (monthly counts), not a universal MODIS-VIIRS conversion

forward_mapping_modis_to_viirs.direction: MODIS 1 km counts -> S-NPP VIIRS 375 m equivalent counts
forward_mapping_modis_to_viirs.purpose: Carries the pre-2012 MODIS record forward onto a 375 m footing so the series can continue on NOAA-20/21 after Suomi-NPP delivery ends.
forward_mapping_modis_to_viirs.caveat: Algebraic inversion of the fitted line, not a separately fitted model: it inherits the same uncertainty and is not validated against NOAA-20 detections. A NOAA-20 leg (VIIRS_NOAA20_SP) must be fitted on the S-NPP / NOAA-20 overlap before the forward series is used operationally.

baseline_definitions.naive_raw_viirs_vs_modis: raw unscaled VIIRS counts spliced onto the MODIS record — the error being illustrated, not a method any analyst would use
baseline_definitions.scalar_ratio_baseline_vs_modis: one scalar, sum(train MODIS) / sum(train VIIRS) = 0.2673 — the honest competing baseline the fitted model must beat

performance_improvement.honest_reading: Most of the correction comes from simple scaling. Against the scalar baseline the fitted model gains only a few per cent, so the contribution of this work is the regional calibration, the bootstrap uncertainty, the sensitivity runs and the held-out test, not the size of the error reduction.

held_out_seasonal_breakdown.note: A single held-out RMSE is dominated by the burning peak. Reported separately so the fit is not judged on six months of the year.

limitations: Region-specific held-out-tested prototype: not a universal MODIS-VIIRS conversion, not a fire-cause classifier, not proof of fire absence.
Regional monthly counts, not paired fire-level detections.
No overpass-time, scan-angle, exact administrative boundary, land-cover or FRP modeling.
FIRMS reports positive detections; non-detection does not prove absence of fire (cloud cover, orbital gaps).
A single scalar ratio already removes most of the sensor step; the fitted line improves on it only marginally, so the error-reduction headline is reported against both baselines.
Held-out accuracy is concentrated in the March-April burning peak; most months carry near-zero detections, so R2 is reported with the seasonal breakdown and with Spearman rank correlation.
The forward MODIS-to-VIIRS mapping is an algebraic inversion, not a model fitted on NOAA-20 data.
NOAA-20 leg status: insufficient_overlap — only 0 overlapping months; at least 24 are required. The record is not extended past the downloaded archive until that leg is fitted.
Per-district fits test spatial consistency but are not independent datasets; the three districts share the same sensors and processing chain.
Suomi-NPP VIIRS delivery permanently ceases November 1, 2026; future operations require NOAA-20/21 refitting.
